timezone_invalid: {option} must be an IANA time zone
slug_underivable: cannot derive a slug from the workspace name; pass --slug
user_email_taken: a user with this email already exists
workspace_slug_taken: a workspace with this slug already exists; pass another --slug
user_not_found: no active user has this email
secret_stdin_tty: pipe the app secret on stdin
secret_stdin_empty: the app secret on stdin is empty
secret_stdin_lines: the app secret on stdin must be one line
provider_unsupported: only bluesky, facebook, instagram, linkedin or threads can be registered
provider_app_not_found: no provider app has this id
key_not_found: no key with this kid for this app
key_not_next: only a next key can be activated; this one is {status}
key_active: an active key cannot be deleted; activate a next key first

match.countPlural=one: key {kid} was retired less than {count} minute ago; connects started before the rotation may still need it
match.countPlural=*: key {kid} was retired less than {count} minutes ago; connects started before the rotation may still need it

key_in_use: key {kid} still signs for connected credentials; they must reconnect or be disconnected before it can be deleted
import_done: restore epoch {epoch}; publishing is paused in restore quarantine
import_next: run `kronaut migrate`, review the quarantined posts, then run `kronaut release`
db_url_invalid: the database URL is not a valid postgres:// URL
db_url_password: the database URL has a malformed password
tool_version_unknown: {tool} must be PostgreSQL {major}, found an unknown version
partial_exists: a .partial file from an earlier export exists; remove it first
no_schema: the database holds no Kronaut schema
never_started: the instance has never started; start the server once, then export
identity_invalid: the identity file holds an invalid age identity
identity_empty: the identity file holds no age identity
archive_undecryptable: cannot decrypt the archive: wrong identity or not an age file
archive_corrupt: the archive is corrupt or truncated
archive_not_file: the archive is not a regular file
archive_changed: the archive changed while it was being imported
archive_outside_whitelist: archive holds an entry outside the whitelist
archive_dump_first: db.dump must be the first entry
archive_manifest_last: manifest.json must be the last entry
archive_incomplete: archive is missing db.dump or manifest.json
archive_media_mismatch: the media entries do not match the manifest
manifest_wrong_format: manifest.json is not a format {format} manifest

match.countPlural=one: the keyring lacks KEK version {versions}; set KRONAUT_KEK_<n> before importing
match.countPlural=*: the keyring lacks KEK versions {versions}; set KRONAUT_KEK_<n> for each before importing

target_db_not_empty: the target database is not empty
target_media_not_empty: the target media directory is not empty
restored_no_state: the restored database has no instance state
media_copy_failed: the database is restored and quarantined (restore epoch {epoch}), but copying media failed: {reason}
